name: Pearl Rabbit Garden Editorial
image_vibe: golden garden whimsy, warm yellow couture

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic golden-hour garden portrait with yellow plaid fashion, pearls, and rabbits.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional blonde woman with soft waves and playful expression, wearing a secure yellow-and-white plaid puff dress with opaque yellow tights and yellow shoes, pearl jewelry, and holding loose decorative pearl leads for three comfortable rabbits while standing upright.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level wide-angle garden frame with green hedges, trees, tiger statue, tiered fountain, golden-hour meadow palette, no graphic lettering on clothing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural golden-hour light, warm skin glow, detailed grass and hair, gentle water sparkle, whimsical editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: RAW photorealistic 35mm portrait, f/2.8, realistic hands, pearls, fabric, rabbits, foliage, and fountain, no text or logo.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic golden-hour garden fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional blonde woman in a secure yellow-and-white plaid puff dress, opaque yellow tights, yellow shoes, pearl jewelry, holding loose decorative pearl leads for three comfortable rabbits while standing upright, green hedges, tiger statue, tiered fountain, 35mm f/2.8, natural texture, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sheer stockings, sexualized bent-over pose, animal distress, tight restraint, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: yellow pearl rabbit reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the garden editorial intent with modest coverage, upright pose, loose leads, and humane animal handling.
